chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Ṭalḥah ibn Zayd, from Ghiyāth ibn Ibrāhīm, from Jaʿfar, from his father, peace be upon them both, who said:
ʿAlī عليه السلام said: “If an umm al-walad kills her master by mistake, then she is free, and no labor-compensation is due from her.”

key_terms.أُمُّ الْوَلَدِ: a slave woman who has borne a child to her master
key_terms.سِعَايَةٌ: obligatory earning or labor imposed to pay a liability

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if an umm al-walad accidentally kills her master?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning an umm al-walad who causes the accidental death of her master. It states that she becomes free and is not required to earn or pay compensation through compelled labor.
